correctness.rationale: For a relatively minimal rational elliptic surface with section and no reducible elliptic fibers, the E8 Mordell–Weil lattice describes every section S_v. The formula S_v·S_w=||v−w||²/2−1 makes each transverse two-section conic singular fiber a norm-four difference. Costa Theorems 3.8 and 4.2 support both the nef degree-two square-zero pencil and exhaustion by singular A2 fibers, respectively. Translation adds 2w to the E8 coordinate of S_0+S_u; all norm-four vectors in a residue class define the same translate orbit because the square-zero/fiber-degree data fix the remaining coefficient. I independently enumerated all 2160 norm-four E8 vectors, formed 135 classes of 16 each, with mod-two quadratic form 136 isotropic classes including zero. Euler number e(X)=12 and smooth P1-bundle e=4 give exactly eight transverse reducible conic fibers.
residual_risks: No classification for reducible elliptic fibers or under full Aut(X); the E8 finite check does not establish the geometric reduction without Costa/Shioda lemmas.
